subject: Old collection links from the schools packs

messages.text:
Hi Luis,

I tried the links in the two teaching packs Ian gave us. The one for the treadle lathe is `/objects/item.asp?id=82`, which makes sense against the sample export. The link for the same lathe in the older pack comes through a folder called Machines and ends in `lathe2.htm`. That address still opens, but the last thing anyone edited on it looks like it was the copyright date.

I'd make the new page address out of the collection number and keep a list of old addresses that point to it. That gives us somewhere to add things like the old teaching link without assuming we can derive them from the export. The thing I don't want to do is send every missing address to the top of the collection. If you're opening links in a class that's as good as a dead link, except you spend longer working out that nothing went wrong at your end.

Ian, do you have a list of the old Machines addresses anywhere?

Anil

Export: no addresses for the Machines folder. The PDFs are the record of what went out.

Ian

Let's keep the links printed in the packs and use the collection number for the new address. We can check those two packs by hand in time for design sign-off. Any old address we can't match should get the missing page, with a link to search the collection.

Thanks,
Luis

Luis Cordero
Lead Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR

I've counted 17 different object links across the two PDFs. I'll put them on the redirect sheet for the build. The lathe got printed twice under different names, so that's the test case I'll use when we have the new page up.

Anil

subject: El menú que va junto a la caja el 1 de noviembre

¿Me mandas antes de las 12 del martes 27 de octubre, hora de Guadalajara, el PDF en media carta del menú del domingo 1? Es el que va en el acrílico junto a la caja de la sucursal chica. Inés recibe el PDF después de mí y lo saca en la impresora de la oficina, así que no necesita rebases. Imprime dos y guarda una copia por si se le cae café encima a la primera, que ya nos pasó.

En el menú de siempre el pan de elote se cobra aparte. Ese domingo va con el café de olla por $95 MXN. ¿Puedes dejar el precio abajo del nombre del combo, grande? En la prueba que hice yo me salió pegadito al de la bebida sola y ya me estaban preguntando en barra si eran dos cobros. El café de olla solo sigue a $52 MXN. La parte de abajo te la puedes brincar completa: el molino de la sucursal chica está en servicio y ese día no vamos a vender bolsas ahí.

Gracias, Mariana
